purpose: Estimate real intervention directions for A_AR and M instead of assuming nominal drug/knockdown selectivity.

preferred_proximal_family.rationale: human AGA study reports DHT dose-associated induction and reduction after AR knockdown

preferred_proximal_family.measurement: AR occupancy at the miR-221 promoter by ChIP/ChIP-qPCR
preferred_proximal_family.rationale: directly binds branch activity closer to receptor-dependent transcription than AR abundance alone

source.citation: Li et al., Int J Biol Sci 2023

A_AR.downstream_context: miR-221 suppresses IGF-1 and reduces DPC/DSC proliferation; anti-miR-221 partially rescues DHT-associated follicle effects in the reported experiments
do_not_collapse: AR protein abundance != AR transcriptional activity
miR-221 abundance != unique AR activity scalar

preferred_proximal_family.rationale: molecular contractile-state proxy localized to the contractile compartment

preferred_proximal_family.measurement: AFM-derived mechanical/contractility readout on patient-derived DS cells
preferred_proximal_family.rationale: moves from signaling proxy toward measured mechanics

preferred_proximal_family.measurement: direct intact-follicle contraction/width trajectory under real-time imaging
preferred_proximal_family.rationale: organ-level physical readout of the target state

do_not_collapse: transcript contractile signature != measured mechanical state

for_each_intervention: measure at least one A_AR-proximal readout
measure at least one M-proximal readout
measure downstream P/function and H-function outputs
system_identification_rule.derive: empirical branch-activity directions first, then compute rank/separation; never assign [0,1] or [1,0] solely from intervention labels
system_identification_rule.success: orthogonal or sufficiently separated measured response directions
system_identification_rule.failure: nominally different interventions produce nearly collinear measured branch directions

claim_boundary: These are measurement candidates for experimental system identification. They are not validated clinical biomarkers or personal treatment-selection tests.
